status.statusBody: No milestone has moved. One decision is waiting on you.
status.thisWeek: Meal logging now works with no signal and syncs the moment you're back online. The barcode scanner read 41 of 42 test products.
status.upNext: Recipe import from a pasted link, and the first working version of the weekly nutrition summary.
status.neededFromYou: Pick one of the two macro-ring styles shown in the preview. We build your choice on Thursday.

requests.title: Choose the macro ring style
requests.body: Style A stacks three thin rings. Style B uses one ring with a segmented bar underneath. Both are live in the prototype's Summary screen.
requests.subNote: Holds up the weekly summary build, starting Thursday 3 Sept
requests.pmNote: Raise a request, set assignee and due date, and choose what the client's buttons say (two options, one acknowledgement, or an action + fallback).

requests.title: Accept the Apple developer invite
requests.body: Sent to both of you on 27 Aug. Accepting it lets us put test builds straight onto your phones instead of emailing links.
requests.note: Not blocking yet. Needed before beta opens 5 Oct.
requests.pmNote: Nudges send automatically at 3 and 7 days. Edit the request to change its buttons, schedule, or close it.

prototype.caption: Prototype r24 · build 0.9.4 — 1 Sept, 18:40
prototype.pmNote: Paste a Figma prototype URL and a TestFlight or Play link; the embed and the buttons update together. Build number, issue count and device list are typed once per push.

milestones.title: Beta opens 5 Oct
milestones.body: You both test on your phones

milestones.title: Store review 30 Oct
milestones.body: A week of slack before launch

decisionsIntro: Everything on this list is settled and being built. If something here is wrong, say so — we change it and date the change.

decisions.body: Primary colour set to #0B7FD4, used for actions only.
decisions.attribution: Agreed by Kaya and Dr. Renner on the Monday call

decisions.body: Recipe import is link-paste only at launch. Photo-to-recipe moves to the first update.
decisions.attribution: Requested by Kaya — protects the launch date

decisions.body: Calorie and macro targets are advisory. No medical or clinical claims in the app or the store listing.
decisions.attribution: Written by Dr. Renner, reviewed by our counsel

decisions.body: Sign-in is Apple and email only. No social logins.
decisions.attribution: Both clients agreed; removes two weeks of privacy review

decisions.body: Offline logging is in scope for launch and is the app's headline difference.
